request.subject: UNIT:DINOSAUR:SWORDSMAN

layers.text: Change three things only. Recolour the hide: the grey-blue head, body, legs and tail become saturated deep blue, colour #24509c, shaded dark navy #16224a on the back, and the brown spots become plain blue. Erase the orange marks on the neck and shoulder: plain deep blue. Remove the small horn on the nose: a round snout. Keep the orange back fins, cream belly, cream tail spikes, pose, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
